text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which race will Hokko Tarumae head to 
after the February Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The truth was revealed— during a TV 
interview."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Then, Hokko Tarumae-san, are you 
going to challenge an overseas race?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to the Middle East. I'm going to take 
on the international GⅠ races in Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as the representative Umamusume of 
Japan?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No—as the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador! 
Spread your wings to the world, surf 
clams!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait! Did that joke fall completely 
flat?!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Ah, no...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! So Tarumae really had her sights 
set on Dubai all along.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a bold move...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The international dirt GⅠ held in Dubai is 
one of the highest-caliber races in the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running well there is tremendously 
difficult. Even so, Hokko Tarumae..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to talk to Tarumae for a 
bit, if that's all right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Copano Rickey wearing a strangely 
tense expression for some reason, we 
headed over to Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Rickey. Did I surprise you? I've 
actually been thinking about it for a 
while now, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
How can we make Tomakomai famous? She 
believes the only way is to shine on the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If I win, Tomakomai's name will spread 
far and wide in an instant!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Then, for the sake of Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's not the only reason, though. One of 
the reasons... is Rickey, too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, me...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. During the February Stakes, I 
realized that at this rate, I might not be 
able to keep winning against Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Then I have no choice but to take on even 
greater challenges and become much, much 
stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can afford to lose to 
Ricky, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey falls silent. Meanwhile, 
from a Trainer's perspective, something 
was bothering me.
choice_data_list:
Are the backup systems and matching all 
good?
Are the backup systems and matching okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... Posture and... matching...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the world isn't so simple that 
enthusiasm alone can guarantee success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It requires meticulous planning, and above 
all, determining whether she's a horse 
girl suited for long-distance travel is 
crucial. When I ask about that—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The backup is fine, but the matching... 
might not be that great."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a laid-back girl born and raised 
in the countryside, so unfamiliar places 
make me a little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae, in that case...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry, though! My love for my 
hometown is more than enough to beat it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, this challenge... is also a 
chance to avenge Falco-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's the same race Falco-san 
challenged before, after all. Back then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san got boxed in from both sides at 
the start, so she couldn't run her usual 
front-runner race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so heartbroken over not being 
able to give it her all... Watching that 
on TV, I just couldn't stop crying, I 
couldn't stop at all...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I've gotten this strong, as 
their junior Umadol, I want to work extra 
hard to make up for all that frustration 
back then!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I can hold on! 
Definitely—no, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Watch me, Rickey! This spring, I'll work 
even harder than you and leave you in the 
dust with a zundoko-dokkoi!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, Hokko Tarumae set off for Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the main event is fast approaching. 
We haven't heard much about how things are 
going on-site, though..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been updated at all. Tarumae's 
Umastagram, lately...
choice_data_list:
I wonder if she's busy preparing for the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's the case, fine... but I 
don't think that's all. Because Tarumae, 
you're—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm Tomakomai's tourism 
ambassador.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I've never 
forgotten to promote Tomakomai. So...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Now that you mention it, that's 
completely true. There's no way they would 
pass up such a prime publicity 
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a slightly... bad feeling about 
this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have told them after all. 
Even knowing they wouldn't believe me...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As for this expedition— I told them it's 
the 'Five Demons.'

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's quite a hazardous inauspicious 
direction. Second-worst direction, right 
behind the most catastrophic 'Total 
Demise'.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That night, when I learned you were going 
on an overseas expedition, Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know Tarumae probably won't believe 
anything I say. But still—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll take a look. If I see a good omen, I 
want to tell them. So... just a little 
peek!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should've told them... Or maybe 
not...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Was it right not to tell them? Once the 
race is over, I hope we can just laugh 
about it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't say anything. Up until now, 
Copano Rickey's feng shui had always...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—They have rarely ever been wrong. And 
then, on race day—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae finishes in 16th place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What happened?! An unbelievable dead last! 
A run completely devoid of her usual 
brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
According to the stable, there were also 
reports that the local water didn't agree 
with her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah... Tarumae... Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae suffered a crushing defeat 
and returned home in despair. But that 
wasn't the end of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An announcement was made that she would be 
taking a break for a while. And just like 
that, Copano Rickey was left without her 
most important rival.
